experiment: Cal-QL-style critic calibration + actor Q-max for offline-to-online fine-tuning
mechanism: Q-loss += calql_alpha * relu(min(Q1,Q2)(s,pi(s)) - V_ref) with V_ref = frozen v11 offline value (requires --offline-value-memory). IQL/weighted-BC analogue of Cal-QL's masked push-down (Eq 5.1): the critic's over-optimistic OOD estimate of current-policy actions is pulled back to the reference value, so the actor term policy_loss -= policy_qmax_lambda * E[min(Q1,Q2)(s,pi(s))] cannot chase boundary hallucinations.

arms.name: calql200_a1.0_l0.3
arms.setup: v11 best_safe init, ups=10, expert 1.0->0.3, guard, exploration 0.1, OVM on
arms.train_validation: capture 0.80-0.92 stable (25ep seed11, every 20ep), colfree 0.96-1.0, minsep >=0.294; NO collapse, best_safe written (ep80)

arms.name: calql200_a0.3_l0.3
arms.train_validation: capture 0.80-0.96, colfree dips to 0.92, safety_failure up to 0.08 at tail (weaker cap -> drifts toward collapse direction)

comparison.bare_Qmax_qmax200: FAILED: validation capture peaked 0.56, colfree 0.4-0.7, no best_safe (collapse to OOD boundary hallucination)

conclusions: VERIFIED: Cal-QL calibration makes the actor Q-max term safe. vs bare Qmax (immediate collapse, capture peak 0.56, no best_safe ever) both calibrated arms ran stable 200ep, wrote best_safe, and kept formal colfree >=0.946. Higher calibration weight is safer: alpha=1.0 flat and stable; alpha=0.3 drifts (robust colfree 0.946 fails gate).

RECOVERY: best calibrated arm (a1.0 best_safe ep80) formal 0.910/0.910 - robust ties the v11 offline original (0.910) and beats every earlier fine-tune variant (naive A 0.880, OVM 0.882); nominal 0.910 beats OVM 0.900 / naive A 0.890. Unlearning trough eliminated.

NOT EXCEEDING EXPERT: best nominal 0.910 vs expert 0.944; no arm passes the nominal>=0.95 gate. Consistent with the earlier headroom probes (no trustworthy improvement room: teacher locally Q-optimal in data, 85.7% of 'better' neighbours are boundary hallucinations): with Q calibrated honest, the actor Q-max has nothing real to grab - the residual gap to the teacher needs better-than-teacher DATA, not a better loss.
STOP per pre-registered rule: loss-only tuning plateaus at ~0.90-0.91 across naive/OVM/Qmax/Cal-QL; further alpha/lambda/episode sweeps will not break the plateau.
